hint_replace: Click a line to edit it in place. Shift-click or drag a box to select several lines for styling. Enter saves, Esc cancels.
hint_text: Drag a box and type. Enter saves, Shift+Enter starts a new line.
stopped_body: PDF Studio has stopped. You can close this tab.
confirm_delete_doc: Delete this document? This cannot be undone.
confirm_redact: Permanently erase everything in this area? The undo history of this file will be cleared.
redact_done: Area erased. Undo history was cleared.
overflow_warning: The new text overlaps nearby content. Check the page.
upload_too_large: This file is larger than {n} MB.

open_first: Open a PDF first, then merge.

err_password_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
readonly_failed: Export failed. Check the passwords and options.
hint_select: Click a line or picture to select it. Drag to move. Right-click a picture for layer and delete options. Shift-click or drag a box to select several lines.
ocr_done: Recognized {n} lines of text. Click a line to edit it.
ocr_none: No text was found on this page.
ocr_confirm: This page already has text. Recognize it again?
ocr_unavailable: Text recognition is not installed. Run install-ocr.command in the project folder, then restart PDF Studio.
style_align_hint: Select several lines, or a line inside a paragraph, to align
font_no_style: The selected font has no bold or italic version.
toc_hint: Each bookmark jumps to a page. Level 2 sits under the level above it.
annots_hint: Edit the text of a comment or remove it. Changes can be undone.
password_needed: This PDF is protected. Enter its open password.
unlocked_copy_notice: This PDF was protected. PDF Studio keeps an unlocked working copy on this computer. Your original file is not changed.
about_support_text: PDF Studio is free and open source. If it saves you time, you can support its development with a donation.
about_copy_hint: Click an address to copy it.
